images.name: Quiet Workshop
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a restrained, BUILDABLE Minecraft Java vanilla-block room design proposal, not fantasy concept art. Landscape image, first-person view from the open front corner looking diagonally into a 14 by 14 block room with 7-block-high walls: show two BACK walls, floor and ceiling. Exactly one unobtrusive 2-block-wide 2-block-high doorway. Every visible architectural cell is an ordinary full opaque 1x1x1 Minecraft cube with recognizable stock 16px vanilla textures and obvious block-scale joints. Walls and ceiling are FLAT continuous planes, decoration only changes which full block occupies each cell. No protruding pillars, no stairs, slabs, arches, furniture, foliage, paintings, machines, glass, portals, carved custom symbols, custom textures, lamps, light-emitting blocks, bloom, PBR, raytracing, fog, or cinematic postprocessing. Use neutral even vanilla ambient lighting. Important: large calm wall fields, low-contrast surfaces, sparse rhythm and small accents; NOT giant checkerboards, gaudy full gold blocks, stripes over every block, or industrial hazard tape everywhere. Keep it plausible as an actual survival Minecraft full-block interior. A small clean title outside the scene at bottom says the specified theme name and 'VANILLA BLOCK STUDY'. This is a proposal visualization, not a game screenshot. Theme title: 'Quiet Workshop'. Palette ONLY smooth stone, light gray concrete, polished andesite, stone bricks, waxed cut copper. Main walls light gray concrete with one stone-brick base row and narrow polished-andesite dividers every 5 blocks, occasional single muted copper block at divider foot. Floor mostly smooth stone with one quiet andesite border, ceiling light gray with two parallel andesite bands. Calm practical modern workshop, sparse copper under 3 percent.
